propositions: The production review bot must be cut over from direct Anthropic API to AWS Bedrock inference profiles with no cross-provider fallback, as a dogfooding measure to surface Bedrock-specific issues before clients encounter them

The review bot service requires three environment variables (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_STANDARD_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_TRIVIAL_MODEL) set to bedrock-qualified inference profile IDs to route the per-pass model split through Bedrock instead of Anthropic

The Dockerfile must install the bedrock extra (pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]) explicitly so the review bot image contains pydantic_ai.providers.bedrock at runtime, or the first Bedrock call will fail with LLMConfigError

A CloudWatch alarm must be declared and applied measuring Bedrock InvokeModel client-error rate via AWS/Bedrock native metrics before the cutover takes effect, to surface provider degradation that fail-closed behavior would otherwise hide

The kill switch recovery path must be proven end-to-end (Anthropic path voting successfully after removing the Bedrock slots) before the cutover is submitted, to ensure a recovery mechanism exists for production
